reviews.review:
To celebrate the return of the green-skinned warmongering, barbaric xenos i decided to play Warhammer 40k Space Marine again. Perfect Idea for Orctober isn´t it?
I played this game back in 2011 on PS3 and i loved it. 
The Game starts great. I felt powerful. Each of my melee hits felt so strong. It felt pretty epic.

But later this feelings changed. The Problem is the lack of different Enemies. Where are all the cool Orcs Warhammer 40k has to offer? Also the Gameplay felt repetitive and shallow after a while.
The Warhammer 40k Universe has so much more to offer.

Don´t get me wrong. It´s a pretty good game, but it feels a little bit flat in the end.
Get it if its on sale!

7/10

I love this game!! The campaign was varied and action filled, as well as a great story-line. The game play is smooth and flows well. The online modes were also brilliant, especially exterminatus! (But is could have done with more maps).

PLEASE, PLEASE, PLEASE make the sequels!!!

One of the best games to play drunk. I got it for super cheap - there is a huge pile of AAA games in my library that I touched and never played again : I really loved playing Warhammer 40K Space Marine. Violent, satisfactory, better than than it looks.

WH40K:SP has about a 7hour long story on hard, cover based combat with no cover system and enemies are always as strong as you are leading to no feeling of actually growing stronger with the game. story is lackluster hitting all the superhero movie beats and [spoiler]final boss is a QTE.[/spoiler] The game expects you to either enter rage mode (which takes you dealing a high amount of damage to obtain and very unforgiving if not used at the right time in a skirmish) or execute enemies (which takes dealing a precise amount of damage delt to them and a willingness to take more damage because you can be hit during the execution animation) to regain health.
   The execute enemies 'feature' runs into the same problem it has in any other game, if you are trying to kill at a range it gives the NPC a chance to un-stagger and regain some health before you can reload your gun.
5/10 okay combat when the game lets you actaully feel like a space marine and not just some grunt.
